question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

One who does not express himself freely.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"One who does not express himself freely"** refers to someone who is reserved and tends to keep to themselves. (जो स्वतंत्र रूप से खुद को व्यक्त नहीं करता है)

 
 
• **Example: **John is often quiet in social situations and prefers to listen rather than speak.
 
 
 
• **"Introvert"** refers to a person who tends to be more reserved, enjoys solitary activities, and feels drained after social interactions. (अंतर्मुखी)
 
 
• **Example: **As an introvert, Sarah finds it exhausting to attend large parties and prefers small gatherings.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that "One who does not express himself freely" is an **'Introvert'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Introvert**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Approachable** (सुगम): Easy to talk to or get along with.

 
 
• **Example:** She is very approachable and always willing to help her colleagues.
 
 
 
• **Immodest** (अशिष्ट): Lacking humility or decency.
 
 
• **Example: **His immodest behavior at the party was quite off-putting.
 
 
 
• **Outgoing** (बहिर्मुखी): Friendly and socially confident.
 
 
• **Example:** Mark is very outgoing and loves meeting new people.
 
 

 

47:Tdb6,

The correct answer is: **Option 4.**
